name: md-books-mcp
description: Look up books and authors, make citations, and get shop links, from Open Library, Library of Congress, Hardcover, Google Books and more.
long_description: Find a book by title, author or ISBN and get its details from several free catalogues. Make a citation in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, BibTeX, Wikipedia, CSL-JSON or a markdown house format. Get ready-made links to shops and libraries, optionally carrying your own Bookshop.org or Amazon affiliate ID. Open Library, the Library of Congress and the other free catalogues need no setup; Google Books and Hardcover need a free key.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Show which book catalogues can be used right now.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search for books by title, author, ISBN or free text.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: Get full details for one book.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Get full details for one author.

tools.name: format_citation
tools.description: Make a citation in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, BibTeX, Wikipedia, CSL-JSON or markdown.

tools.name: find_elsewhere
tools.description: Get ready-made search links for shops and libraries, with optional affiliate IDs.

google_books_api_key.title: Google Books API key (optional)
google_books_api_key.description: A free key from Google Cloud Console (enable the Books API). Without it, Google Books is skipped and everything else still works.

hardcover_api_key.title: Hardcover API key (optional)
hardcover_api_key.description: From your Hardcover account: Settings, Hardcover API. Without it, Hardcover is skipped.

bookshop_affiliate_id.title: Bookshop.org affiliate ID (optional)
bookshop_affiliate_id.description: Letters, numbers, - and _ only. If set, Bookshop.org (UK) links for an ISBN carry your ID and are labelled as affiliate links.

amazon_associate_tag.title: Amazon Associates tag for amazon.co.uk (optional)
amazon_associate_tag.description: For example yourname-21. If set, an Amazon UK link is added, labelled as an affiliate link.

contact.title: Contact email or website (optional)
contact.description: Sent to the free catalogues (Open Library, Crossref, BookBrainz, Wikidata) so they can identify polite traffic. Some give faster limits when it is set.
